title: Circularity Frontier: per-capita cost and CO2 indicators of the construction and demolition waste loop and on-site recycling scenarios, Extremadura, Spain
description: Model, input data and figure code accompanying the manuscript 'Selective On-Site Recycling Removes the Equity Cost of Construction Waste Mandates in Low-Density Regions'. For each of the 383 municipalities of Extremadura (32 CDW plant groups over the real road network) it builds per-capita cost (EUR/inhab/yr) and CO2 (kg/inhab/yr) indicators of the CDW loop and evaluates on-site (mobile) crushing scenarios against the plant-based baseline: S0 current system, S1 blanket mandate, S2 selective by Pareto dominance, S2_cap with an annual fleet capacity, and S3 with cluster-shared mobile units. Includes a 378-combination sensitivity grid (v_op x F x EF1 x p) and a penetration sweep. Pure Python standard library; matplotlib is required only for the figures. Input data are derived from the open-access article Torrecilla-Pinero et al., Waste Management Bulletin 4 (2026) 100355, DOI 10.1016/j.wmb.2026.100355, CC BY 4.0.
